plan.notes: Source: official ASU Degree Search major map for 'English (Writing, Rhetorics and Literacies), BA' (program code LAENGWBA), 2024-2025 catalog year: https://degrees.asu.edu/major-map/ASU00/LAENGWBA/null/ALL/2024 . Transcription method: automated parse of every term row (courses, credit hours, minimum grades) from the official major map page on 2026-09-30, spot-checked against the rendered page. Term names use ASU's own 'Term N' numbering. General Studies designations (HUAD, SOBE, SCIT, AMIT, GCSI, CIVI, SUST) are modeled as choice:true student-choice slots; OR-options are choice slots naming the alternatives. Per-course prerequisites are NOT listed on the ASU major map, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty. Campus: Tempe. Major map track groups (Directed Electives) are elective choice lists transcribed as choice slots with the group's courses as options.
